Jin Sha Portrait

Jin Sha, also known by her stage name Kym, is a Chinese singer and actress born on March 14, 1983, in Shanghai. She first gained attention with her debut single "他不爱我" and has since built a career in both music and acting.

In this professional studio portrait, Jin Sha wears a delicate pale pink dress with feathered details. Her long, wavy brown hair frames her face, and her subtle makeup accentuates her eyes and lips. The neutral gray backdrop and soft lighting create an elegant and refined atmosphere, highlighting her poised demeanor.

sources.title: 他不愛我 - song and lyrics by 金莎 | Spotify
sources.description:
Cover Portrait of 金莎

The image features Chinese singer 金莎 leaning against a tree trunk, her long brown hair cascading over a white knit sweater. Soft natural light filters through the surrounding foliage, creating a serene and contemplative atmosphere. She looks off to the side with a thoughtful expression, set against a blurred background of greenery and hints of a garden.

This photograph serves as the cover art for her 2019 single "他不愛我," as displayed on Spotify. The minimalist composition and gentle lighting emphasize a quiet, introspective mood that complements the song’s emotional tone.

sources.description:
金莎花卉肖像

This promotional portrait of Taiwanese singer 金莎 features her reclining on a lush bed of multicolored flowers. She wears a flowing white dress with ruffled sleeves, and her soft makeup and gentle gaze create a serene, romantic atmosphere. The floral backdrop includes roses and blossoms in shades of pink, yellow, and purple, enhancing the image's dreamy aesthetic.

The image is used on LINE MUSIC's Taiwanese artist profile page for 金莎, where fans can explore her albums, songs, and biography. The harmonious composition and vibrant colors emphasize her elegance and charm, making it a fitting visual introduction to her musical catalog.

sources.description:
金莎’s SoundCloud Single Artwork

This 500×500 cover art features Chinese singer 金莎 in a close-up portrait. She wears a white feathered top and long, beaded earrings, her hair styled in soft waves. The neutral gray background and gentle lighting emphasize her smooth skin and delicate makeup, conveying an elegant and refined mood.

The artwork corresponds to the SoundCloud track "爱的魔法," released on January 7, 2013. Metadata reveals that 金莎 wrote the lyrics and 刘佳 composed the music. The streaming page includes snippets of the Chinese lyrics and multilingual user comments, inviting listeners to enjoy the song on SoundCloud.

金莎 – 星月神話 (Legends)

Chinese pop artist 金莎 graces the cover of her 2010 single "星月神話," also known by its English title "Legends." The image features her in a fluffy, light-colored coat and a patterned top, standing against a luminous white backdrop. Her name appears in Chinese characters above the gold-scripted title "Legends," reflecting the song’s elegant and dreamy aesthetic.

Released in 2010, "星月神話" is available on Spotify, where this artwork serves as the official track image. The design emphasizes a soft, ethereal mood, aligning with the song’s lyrical themes and 金莎’s pop sensibility.

Jin Sha’s Lantern Portrait

Jin Sha appears in a refined studio portrait for Cosmopolitan China, peeking from behind a tall white lantern. She wears a black ensemble and silver earrings, her dark hair swept back with a few loose strands. The soft, even lighting accentuates her fair complexion and red lips, lending an elegant, minimalist aesthetic.

This image is part of a magazine collaboration titled “玩美COSMO x 金莎重塑生活大片.” Creative director and photographer Guo Jinjin led the shoot, with retouching by Yang Xia and production by OMG Wanmei Ka and Guo Jinjin Commercial Photography.

sources.title: 金莎新歌合作藤原育郎 網友：六年不負等待 - 每日頭條
sources.description:
金莎錄音室自拍

金莎近日在微博上宣布，自己正在籌備新歌，並有幸與日本音樂人藤原育郎老師合作。她在長文中表達了對藤原育郎的敬佩與愛戴，並透露在製作過程中不斷鞭策自己，力求更優秀。

配圖中，金莎身穿牛仔外套，坐在錄音室內，對著鏡頭露出上揚的微笑。背景可見錄音設備與隔音牆，燈光柔和，營造出輕鬆愉快的工作氛圍。粉絲留言「念念不忘必有迴響」，對她六年後的新歌充滿期待。
